structured_output.summary: I found no blocking problems. My unit probes (registry, Caddyfile/JSON parsing, defaults, stats accounting) and my integration probe (detached upgrade through encode and an intercept with a status matcher) all pass. Two gaps are advisory: detached streams to dynamic upstreams are not closed on reload, and the handshake-logging assertions for non-detached or h2 paths are thin.

findings.text: Cleanup only closes detached streams for h.Upstreams; streams to dynamic upstreams are never closed on reload, and no test covers that case.
streamLevel re-parses the level string on every call. This is harmless, but a level parsed once at Provision time would be simpler.

coverage.note: Stream A is closed and stream B still echoes after the reload. My registry probe also showed that closeUpstream closes only the named upstream.
The Caddyfile and JSON parsing tests plus the caddyfiletest adaptation file cover this. My probe checked the Caddyfile to JSON round trip.
The stream stays open during the delay and closes after it. TestStreamDefaultClosedOnReload covers the no-delay case.

Parsing is covered. TestStreamDetachedAccessLog asserts skip_handshake suppresses the 101 entry and that the handshake is logged by default. My probe checked the DEBUG default and rejection of an invalid level.
The test asserts the close entry's level, logger, upstream, byte counts, duration and result.

TestInterceptUpgrade covers intercept. Each echo would read a stray second response if one were written after the 101, so it catches that. My probe stacked encode and a status-matched handle_response in detached mode.
A raw-connection write leaves Size at 0, while a write through the wrapper counts. The streaming code calls UnwrapHijackedConn.
The test speaks real h2 frames with a :protocol pseudo-header in a GODEBUG child process. HTTP/1.1 detached upgrades are covered by TestStreamDetachedReload.
I did not read this test, so the name and line are a guess. My probe checked that finish fires once under 8 concurrent calls, and the harness has already confirmed the file passes.
The integration suite covers reload in both modes, h2 extended CONNECT, encode, intercept and detached access logging, all against a real server and clients.

Unit tests cover the registry, config parsing, metrics, recorder hijack and encode hijack. Intercept has no unit test and production intercept.go is unchanged, so it is covered only by the integration tests.
